theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.56%) and Communication Svcs (+1.26%) led the market today, while Materials (-0.85%) and Health Care (-0.37%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.24% versus +0.24% for defensives and +0.40% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.97%, Dow +1.14%, Nasdaq +1.34% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.35%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 2.04% to 14.92, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.74% to $4,554.90, crude oil was little changed at $91.84, and bitcoin gained 4.75% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
